Workflow: find_and_take_object
When to use: when an object needs to be located and picked up from a receptacle or surface
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle} ({searching for the object})
2. take {object} from {receptacle} ({picking up the object})

Workflow: go_to_and_place_object
When to use: when an object is in hand and needs to be placed in a specific destination

1. go to {destination} ({navigating to the target location})
2. move {object} to {destination} ({placing the object in the destination})
